question: Does the frozen rank48 source-to-weight-reader circuit transfer to held-out capable construction and lexicon banks?
frozen_program: Support is the selected rank48 arm (rank49 minus L1H5). Projectors, attention weight pullbacks, rank64 MLP covectors, actuation, and thresholds are unchanged.
ood_population: Temporal fresh-v12 A1/A2 and is/was fresh-lexicon-v11 A1/A2, selected only by their already sealed native capability receipts; temporal-v12 P rows are controls. Circuit support was selected on temporal-v13/iswas-v12 and reader bases were trained on temporal-v11/iswas-v10.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_finiteness_a: all authorities replay, 48 frozen sites execute, target source changes one aligned token, values are finite, and <=22 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_ood_coordinates_transfer: both cross-fits have every coordinate projection >=0.75 and mean residual <=0.20
predictions.pred_c_ood_behavior_transfer: both fits have per-task behavior projection >=0.80 and worst target residual <=0.15
predictions.pred_d_ood_controls_are_selective: both fits have control margin RMS <=0.10, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02, and flip fraction <=0.05
predictions.pred_e_ood_crossfit_is_stable: minimum coordinate projections differ by <=0.05 and per-task behavior projections differ by <=0.05 across fits

decision: Passing promotes rank48 from an in-population circuit candidate to a lexical/construction OOD source-to-weight-reader program. Failure freezes further pruning and localizes transfer failure by coordinate before any optimization.
